set.body: Add shared JVM/JS tests and docs for the CPCA planning layer. Acceptance: PlanSuite covers CpcaArtifact execution, row-basis reuse across ROIs, ROI-local column basis validation, impossible-rank failures, and partition totalSS against the selected ROI table; modules/multivar/README.md and docs/module-relations.md state that formulas and metadata adapters belong above multivar.
set.title: CPCA: planner tests and adapter boundary docs
